sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Direct match on value, day, and recency claim.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Document is J.P. Morgan Rates Strategy speaking in first person; 'JPMorgan' attribution and the steepener/front-end characterization both match.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: Trade level, direction (pay 5s30s), and stop match exactly; 'We' is J.P. Morgan per the byline.

sentences.span: Citi's rates desk, by contrast, sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold on a closing basis.
sentences.why: Direct match on attribution, characterization, and level.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener; a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
sentences.why: Day, consensus figure, and both conditional outcomes (hot validates, soft doesn't reverse) match; 'the steepener' correctly refers to JPMorgan's own call ('our steepener') established earlier in the same note.
